title: AMAGO: Scalable In-Context Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Agents

layout.note: A narrow numbered text strip with a globe and a robot icon at the left; to its right five stacked layers drawn bottom-up: token chips, Timestep Encoders, black representation tiles, one full-width AMAGO banner, and an actor, latent-estimate, critic triple, with three aligned timestep columns (0, j, H) separated by ellipses.

lesson: Unroll a sequence model by drawing the first, a generic and the last timestep as aligned columns with ellipses, one small encoder per column under a single full-width banner for the sequence model, and repeat the output heads per column; keep one fixed colour per token type so it can be followed up the stack.
